en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a row of modernist residential houses on a sloping street. The buildings have flat roofs, clean rectangular lines, and a mix of smooth facades with horizontal siding. In the foreground, a few children sit and play near two small bicycles. The scene is quiet and suburban, with sparse trees in the background. Printed text appears at the bottom left of the image.
